notes: Scorecards and ball-by-ball: Cricsheet (https://cricsheet.org), Open Data Commons Attribution licence. Data reconciled against a second independent collection (data/reconcile/REPORT.md).

NPL 2026 matches 14-21 have scorecards rebuilt from nplt20league.com pages but no ball-by-ball: they replay at scorecard granularity (points land when the match ends). 3 of those innings fail the source's own arithmetic and are marked unverified.
Fixtures, squads, player bios: Wikipedia season pages and player articles (CC BY-SA 4.0).
Player photos: Wikimedia Commons / free files only, each with its own licence and author shown in the app.
Franchise colours, abbreviations and logos are placeholders; no free source publishes them.
Run-out direct hits are not recorded by Cricsheet: a run-out credited to one fielder scores as direct, two or more fielders share the assisted points.
Wicket-keeper identity per match is not recorded: the WK role comes from the squad lists, inferred from stumpings where the list has no role.
Roles missing from every source were inferred from match data (bowling workload, batting position); 42 inferred, 22 defaulted to batter (never played).
Overseas status unknown for 59 players (no nationality in any source); they are treated as domestic.

Fantasy start prices are derived: from the previous season's real fantasy points per match where the player played 3+ matches, otherwise from role, overseas status, captaincy and the published auction category.
